causal_chain: physical affected slots -> inverse bank mapping -> logical word/bit sets -> errors per codeword -> decoder observation -> service outcome -> retry/scrub events -> energy/carbon

topology_scenarios.BEST_CASE_INTERLEAVING: Each affected bit reaches a different codeword; optimistic bound, not an I1/I2 measurement.
topology_scenarios.NOMINAL_PARAMETRIC: An explicitly chosen number of codewords share the event; parameter, not a fitted probability model.
topology_scenarios.WORST_CASE_CLUSTERING: All affected bits reach one codeword; conservative clustering bound.

blocking_evidence: Complete source-hashed bitcell coordinates joined through SRAM address/column selection plus a calibrated spatial upset distribution.
